desc: Parse H, W and grid rows; convert each row string to an integer bitmask and build freq array of size 1<<W.
Build cost array cost[mask]=min(popcount(mask), W-popcount(mask)) for all masks.
Implement integer Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform for XOR convolution (forward transform, pointwise multiply, inverse transform divided by 1<<W).
Compute convolution of freq and cost, take minimum over all column-flip masks, and output answer.
Verify edge cases: H=1, W=1, all-zero rows, all-one rows, and compare with brute force on small random cases if needed.
